Hello everyone.

Today is a day of celebration; a day we can finally end all wars and seek within ourselves to find what we've been longing for all these countless millennia: another WhoaVerse theme.

I present the Typogra theme! Typogra's name comes from the greek words τύπος typos 'form' and γράφειν graphein 'to write'. Well, partially. Not directly. It mostly comes from a shortened word for 'typography', but that's a secret.

Get it here.

Typogra's style is based on typography (even though there's barely a relation to the name, believe me) and focuses on whitespace and minimal graphics. The theme suits text-based subverses and subverses with a 'type' focus. Basically, in layman's terms: potential side effects may arise if you style a subverse that doesn't have text. Just kidding — about the 'potential' part.

The theme still needs a few tweaks and needs to be tested to find those sneaky elements that passed my ultimate vision. You're probably not going to find them, though — you know, with your inferior vision. But, in the 0% chance you do, please let me know.

As for the specifics, mainly:

  • Documentation. Yep, even the simplest of things need an instruction manual (disregard if you are a male).
  • Customization. Currently, what you see is what you get, unless you know basic CSS. I'm thinking probably a few different colors and some tweak options.

I was never good at goodbyes, so, even though there's supposed to be a cool, derpy conclusion like "We'll, that's it! Download if you like it! Like, comment, and subscribe!", I'm going to leave it up to your imagination to end this.
